newsitem.title: FRANCE: FIGURE SKATING-GRITSCHUK, PLATOV WIN DANCE CROWN.
newsitem.headline: FIGURE SKATING-GRITSCHUK, PLATOV WIN DANCE CROWN.

text.p: Oksana Gritschuk and Evgeny Platov produced a spectacular interpretation of Arab culture and gained a second set of perfect 6.0 scores to retain their European ice dance title on Friday.
The Olympic and world champions turned to the Middle East for inspiration and their evocative creation was rewarded with another clutch of maximum scores from the nine-judge panel.
Their 6.0s for artistry gave them 12 for the competition. They received six on Thursday for the presentation of their original dance, the tango.
Their spectacular programme was performed to music by the former lead singler of the pop group Genesis, Peter Gabriel.

Fellow Russians Anjelika Krylova and Oleg Ovsiannikov skated a highly dramatic and passionate dance to a piece of music called "Masquerade" by Russian composer Khatchaturian and gained a deserved second place.
On another night against lesser rivals, it would have been worth victory.
French couple Sophie Moniotte and Pascal Lavanchy held on to take third place from team mates Marina Anissina and Gwendal Peizerat, who also skated an Arab number.
